title: Neural Networks — A Stack of Helpful Filters
key_insight: A neural network uses layers. Early layers notice small patterns, later layers combine them, and a final layer turns the combined evidence into an answer.
body:
## A Stack of Helpful Filters

A photo arrives as millions of color numbers, but the answer needed is simply “cat or dog?” One rule cannot bridge that gap cleanly.

A neural network uses layers. Early layers notice small patterns, later layers combine them, and a final layer turns the combined evidence into an answer.

Connections carry adjustable numbers called weights. Training changes the weights so useful signals grow stronger and misleading signals grow weaker.
common_mistakes: Every layer stores only words and never numbers.
Training keeps all weights fixed forever.
Adding layers guarantees a correct answer without data.
mini_exercise: Sketch the situation in “A Stack of Helpful Filters” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Neural networks are the shared foundation of modern image, language, speech, and recommendation systems.
explain_back_prompt: Using the “A Stack of Helpful Filters” situation, explain Neural Networks without assuming the listener knows deep learning.
